0022600199.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 1-3 on the road, 5th in the Atlantic and 13th in the East) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home, 4th in the Southwest and 10th in the West), with Brooklyn on a one-game win streak and Dallas also on a W1 streak. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg, bruise), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Dallas took the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
